description: Retrieval evaluation set. Relevant chunk IDs were chosen by reading the statute text (which provision a lawyer would cite for the question), before running any retriever. Chunk IDs refer to data/processed/chunks.jsonl.

queries.query: Rule 6(3) seller shall not refuse to take back defective goods or refund consideration
queries.why: E-Commerce Rules 6(3) (marketplace sellers) and 7(4) (inventory entities): no refusal of take-back/refund for defective goods

queries.query: The online store won't accept the return of the broken blender I bought or give my money back
queries.why: Same duties as q01, phrased without legal vocabulary

queries.query: Maine order cancel kiya tha lekin abhi tak paisa wapas nahi aaya
queries.why: E-Commerce Rule 4(10): refunds of accepted refund requests within a reasonable period

queries.query: ऑनलाइन मंगाया सामान कभी डिलीवर नहीं हुआ और विक्रेता पैसे वापस नहीं कर रहा
queries.why: Rules 6(3)/7(4) cover refusal of refund incl. late delivery

queries.query: How long do I have to file a consumer complaint?
queries.why: CPA Section 69 (two years) and Procedure Regulation 14 (limitation)

queries.query: उपभोक्ता शिकायत दर्ज करने की समय सीमा क्या है?
What does section 2(28) say about misleading advertisement?
Ad mein jo features dikhaye the woh product mein nahi hain, yeh jhoota vigyapan hai
queries.why: Misleading-ad definition; Rules 6(3)/7(4) cover goods not as advertised

queries.query: What penalty applies for a false or misleading advertisement?
grievance officer must acknowledge the complaint within forty-eight hours
Company ke grievance officer ka naam aur contact kahan milega, complaint kaise karun
queries.why: Rule 4(4)-(5) grievance officer details; Rule 5(3) marketplace must display grievance mechanism

queries.query: Which commission should I file in if the product cost less than one crore rupees?
The website showed a low price but added extra charges only at checkout
दोषपूर्ण सामान के मामले में जिला आयोग क्या आदेश दे सकता है?
queries.why: CPA Section 39(1): orders of the District Commission

queries.query: Can I file a consumer complaint online electronically?
queries.why: CPA Section 35(1) proviso: complaint may be filed electronically
